summary.motive: Establish the pure wide-zone stretch picture that every boot, dagger, and crosser companion in the family borrows from.
summary.whyItWorks: The full-front reach wash gives the defense no stationary blocking point, so the playside linebacker must run laterally with flow; the guard's climb arrives precisely where he crosses, and the bend read exploits the sealed edge.
summary.failureMode: A 3-tech who fights laterally instead of getting reached keeps his outside arm free, squeezing the crease before the bend decision and forcing the bounce into the sky safety.

beats.title: The Reach Gets Going
beats.text: All five linemen take lateral reach steps with the tight end driving into the edge setter — the entire front is washed toward the boundary in one coordinated motion that defines every look in this system.

beats.title: Mesh Point Sells the Handoff
beats.text: The QB extends the mesh ride while the back flattens his path behind it, forcing both edge defenders to commit to a run they cannot yet rule out.

beats.title: The Playside Linebacker Flows
beats.text: MIKE keys the pullers-less wash and runs the sideline over the top — but the guard climb cuts him off exactly where the crease opens. He is the defender this whole scheme family attacks.

beats.title: Bend Decision at the Second Level
beats.text: The back presses vertical then bends behind the climbing guards rather than bouncing to the SS fill — the bend read turns an eight-yard stretch into a chunk gain.

relations.tell: The ball actually goes to the back — no boot pivot, no pocket reset; the QB's ride ends in a carried-out fake rather than a throw.
